scenes.visual: Title card: Adding Up Noisy Evidence.

scenes.tts: A monkey watches a cloud of moving dots. It must decide which way they are going. How does it turn noise into a choice?
scenes.visual: A dark field of white dots. Most jitter at random; a few drift rightward together. The question appears as on-screen text.
scenes.narration: A monkey watches a cloud of moving dots. It must decide which way they are going. How does it turn noise into a choice?

scenes.tts: Some dots move together, and the rest move at random. The share moving together is called coherence.
scenes.visual: Coherent dots tinted gold, random dots grey. Label: coherence = % of dots moving together. A slider moves from 51.2% to 3.2%, and the gold dots thin out.
scenes.narration: Some dots move together, and the rest move at random. The share moving together is called coherence.

scenes.tts: The monkey answers with a quick eye movement to one of two targets, whenever it is ready.
scenes.visual: Two target dots appear left and right of the patch. An eye icon makes a fast jump to the right target. Label: saccade.
scenes.narration: The monkey answers with a quick eye movement to one of two targets, whenever it is ready.

scenes.tts: Stronger motion gives faster and more accurate choices. With no net motion at all, the choices fall to chance.
scenes.visual: Two small graphs with coherence along the bottom: accuracy rising from 50% (chance) at 0%; reaction time falling as coherence rises.
scenes.narration: Stronger motion gives faster and more accurate choices. With no net motion at all, the choices fall to chance.

scenes.tts: Meanwhile, averaged over many trials, a neuron in its parietal cortex fires faster and faster. Is it making the decision? Hold that question.
scenes.visual: A side view of a monkey brain with the parietal cortex highlighted. Beside it, a firing-rate line averaged over many trials rises over time, labelled: average of many trials. A small card: Is this neuron deciding?
scenes.narration: Meanwhile, averaged over many trials, a neuron in its parietal cortex fires faster and faster. Is it making the decision? Hold that question.

scenes.tts: Any single moment of the dots tells you very little. Each glimpse is a weak hint, buried in noise.
scenes.visual: A brief snippet of the dots at 3.2% coherence, with short motion trails. An arrow for the true direction is tiny beside a large, random arrow labelled noise.
scenes.narration: Any single moment of the dots tells you very little. Each glimpse is a weak hint, buried in noise.

scenes.tts: So keep a running total. Count each glimpse toward one direction or the other.
scenes.visual: A tally bar below the dots ticks up for each rightward glimpse and down for each leftward one.
scenes.narration: So keep a running total. Count each glimpse toward one direction or the other.

scenes.tts: Hints toward the true direction pile up in step. The random jiggle points every which way, so it partly cancels.
scenes.visual: Many tally traces fan out over time. Their mean, a bold line, rises straight; the grey spread around it widens more slowly.
scenes.narration: Hints toward the true direction pile up in step. The random jiggle points every which way, so it partly cancels.

scenes.tts: Here is a question. You watch four times as long. Is your running total four times as reliable?
scenes.visual: On-screen card: watch 4 times as long. Reliable 4 times over? The fan of traces freezes.
scenes.narration: Here is a question. You watch four times as long. Is your running total four times as reliable?

scenes.visual: The question stays on screen; a small countdown ring runs.

scenes.tts: No. It is only twice as reliable.
scenes.visual: The answer appears on screen: twice as reliable.
scenes.narration: No. It is only twice as reliable.

scenes.tts: The signal grows in step with time. The noise grows too, but only as the square root of time.
scenes.visual: On-screen pair after four times as long: signal × 4, noise × 2, so signal ÷ noise × 2. The mean line and the spread are marked.
scenes.narration: The signal grows in step with time. The noise grows too, but only as the square root of time.

scenes.tts: Assume each glimpse carries the same average signal, with independent noise of the same spread. Reliability here means signal divided by that spread. It grows as the square root of the samples added.
scenes.visual: Formula card: reliability = signal ÷ noise, which grows as √n. Label under the formula: same mean signal; independent noise with equal finite variance; noise = standard deviation. A small note: not the same as percent correct.
scenes.narration: Assume each glimpse carries the same average signal, with independent noise of the same spread. Reliability here means signal divided by that spread. It grows as the square root of the samples added.

scenes.tts: That explains the behaviour. Weak motion gives a small push per glimpse, so the total takes longer to become trustworthy.
scenes.visual: Back to the chronometric curve: the slow reaction times at weak motion are highlighted.
scenes.narration: That explains the behaviour. Weak motion gives a small push per glimpse, so the total takes longer to become trustworthy.

scenes.tts: Waiting longer buys accuracy and costs time. So a brain that adds up evidence needs a rule for when to stop.
scenes.visual: A balance scale tips between a clock and a target. A dashed horizontal line appears over the tally traces, with a question mark: when to stop?
scenes.narration: Waiting longer buys accuracy and costs time. So a brain that adds up evidence needs a rule for when to stop.

scenes.tts: The same arithmetic works across neurons. It helps explain why some effects of attention matter. The lesson returns to that.
scenes.visual: The tally traces dissolve into a row of many neurons whose signals feed one downstream cell.
scenes.narration: The same arithmetic works across neurons. It helps explain why some effects of attention matter. The lesson returns to that.

scenes.tts: Adding up noisy evidence makes it more reliable, because the signal adds in step while the noise partly cancels.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: add up noisy evidence; the signal adds in step, the noise partly cancels.
scenes.narration: Adding up noisy evidence makes it more reliable, because the signal adds in step while the noise partly cancels.
